title: UAAP: Mongcopa powers FEU in statement win against La Salle
summary: Kirby Mongcopa powered Far Eastern University to a statement win against defending champion De La Salle University in UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball on Wednesday at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay.
